title: Roti Canai
description: Roti Canai is a dish from Malaysia prepared with all-purpose flour, thai yellow curry paste, coconut milk. This is a home-scale version with measured ingredients in the individual steps where they are used. Serve the roti with a quick yellow-curry coconut sauce; canai traditionally requires repeatedly stretched laminated dough.

steps.instruction: Mix the dough ingredients, knead until smooth and elastic, then cover and rest for about 25 minutes.
Rest the oiled dough, then repeatedly stretch each piece paper-thin, fold into layers and coil it loosely before flattening into roti canai.
Heat the pan over medium heat, shape or spoon out portions, and fry for about 18 minutes total until golden on both sides and fully cooked.
Cook the listed sauce ingredients over medium-low heat for about 9 minutes until aromatic and slightly thickened.
